title: Social intent registration
description: POST /api/social/intents body (T-024). Closed: the action, the presale, the signed transaction's digest, and optionally the item the viewer acted through and their why. Only action "commit" is accepted; "buy" and "sell" belong to the swap feature and are refused with invalid_request until it exists. The why's text rules (NFC, trimmed, 1 to 280 code points, one line, no link, no blocked term) are not enforced here: a failed why is reported in the answer and the intent is still recorded, because the transaction is already signed. The three amount fields are the commit's transaction-log facts (R3-27): the coin it is counted in, its atoms in that coin, and its dollar value at submission; quote_amount requires quote_type.

transaction_bytes.description: Canonical base64 full Sui TransactionData bytes. Required before execution; digest and sender must match the caller’s server-proven Blast wallet.
